answer: In an AI-agent economy, Sybil attacks are resisted by mandating that every identity sustain a continuous computational voyage of unique hardware-attested puzzles. At the dawn of each epoch agents must re-solve resource-intensive tasks verified by a shared oasis of validators; the electricity and silicon cost multiplies directly with each fake identity, so an attacker who wants many votes pays a linear energy penalty that quickly exceeds any potential gain from the inflated stake.
